author: Benjamin Ruiz
text: The owner was very helpful with sharing his knowledge.  I replaced my pump and explained it all to me so I was able to complete the job. He also came out very fast to pump out my septic tanks.  I would highly recommend....Thank you

author: Susan Nikolai
text: Called because our alarm went off on our system. They were quick to accommodate us!  They then educated me on cleaning my filter and sent pictures to another company to help us!  Only charged for cleaning the filter too. Would highly recommend!

author: Kelly Shinall
text: Thoroughly explained everything and provided great service. Showed up when promised.  Love the follow up and two year reminder process. Very friendly and helpful.

author: C Parks
text: Arrived in a timely manner.  Very professional and cleaned up all the mess. Gave great advice on maintaining my system. Very reasonable price. Didn't try to up sale me for services I didnt need. I have a 1500 gallon tank, so price may seem high, but lower than some places quoted me.

author: Deborah Campiti
text: Vaughn educated me on my second tank that a previous septic company did not even bother pumping. He is very knowledgeable. I highly recommend this company!!!!
